Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ২) If 20% of (A + B) = 50% of (A - B), then find B : A
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Question: If 20% of (A + B) = 50% of (A - B), then find B : A

Solution: 
20% of (A + B) = 50% of (A - B)
⇒ (A + B) × 20/100 = (A - B) × 50/100
⇒ (A + B)/5 = (A - B)/2
⇒ 2 (A + B) = 5 (A - B)
⇒ 2A + 2B = 5A - 5B 
⇒ 5A - 2A = 2B + 5B
⇒ 3A = 7B
⇒ A/B = 7/3
∴ B/A = 3/7
= 3 : 7

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ৩) The ratio of income and expenditure of a person is 7 : 5, If he saves Tk. 9000 per annum, what is his monthly income?
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Question: The ratio of income and expenditure of a person is 7 : 5, If he saves Tk. 9000 per annum, what is his monthly income?

Solution: 
Let, income = 7x
and expenditure = 5x 
Then,
7x - 5x = 9000
⇒ 2x = 9000
∴ x = 4500

Annual income = 7x = 7 × 4500 = Tk. 31500
Monthly income = 31500/12 = Tk. 2625

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ৪) The Mathematics textbook for Class VII has 320 pages. The chapter ‘Symmetry’ runs from page 261 to page 272. The ratio of the number of pages of this chapter to the total number of pages of the book is
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Question: The Mathematics textbook for Class VII has 320 pages. The chapter ‘Symmetry’ runs from page 261 to page 272. The ratio of the number of pages of this chapter to the total number of pages of the book is

Solution: 
The chapter ‘Symmetry’ runs for pages = 272 - 261 + 1
= 12

The ratio of the number of pages of this chapter to the total number of pages of the book is = 12 : 320
= 3 : 80

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ৫) Rahim and Karim started a business investing Tk. 26000 and Tk. 30000 respectively. Out of a total profit of Tk. 7000, Rahim's share is -
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Question: Rahim and Karim started a business investing Tk. 26000 and Tk. 30000 respectively. Out of a total profit of Tk. 7000, Rahim's share is -

Solution:
Given,
Investment ratio = 26000 : 30000
= 13 : 15
Sum of the ratio's = 13 + 15 = 28

∴ Rahim's share = 7000 × (13/28)
= Tk. 3250

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ৭) P and Q started a business in the ratio of 2 : 3. After, 1 year P left the business but Q continued. After 2 years they had the profit of Tk. 26,000. What is the profit of Q?
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Question: P and Q started a business in the ratio of 2 : 3. After, 1 year P left the business but Q continued. After 2 years they had the profit of Tk. 26,000. What is the profit of Q?

Solution:
Let the initial capital of P and Q be 2x and 3x respectively
Then, ratio of profits
= 2x × 12 : 3x × 24
= 24x : 72x
= 1 : 3

∴ Q's share
= 26000 × (3/4)
= Tk. 19500.

Brown cover books 3x

⇒ x = 18/2 = 9

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ৯) Labib started a business with Tk. 2100 and is joined afterward by Shishir with Tk. 3600. After how many months did Shishir join if the profits at the end of the year are divided equally?
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Question: Labib started a business with Tk. 2100 and is joined afterward by Shishir with Tk. 3600. After how many months did Shishir join if the profits at the end of the year are divided equally?

Solution:
Suppose,
Shishir joined after x months.

Then,
2100 × 12 = 3600 × (12 - x)
⇒ 252 = 432 - 36x
⇒ 36x = 180
∴ x = 5

∴ Shishir joined after 5 months

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ১০) If a bus travels 160 km in 4 hours and a train travels 320 km in 5 hours at uniform speeds, then the ratio of the distances traveled by them in one hour is
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Question: If a bus travels 160 km in 4 hours and a train travels 320 km in 5 hours at uniform speeds, then the ratio of the distances traveled by them in one hour is 

Solution: 
Distance traveled by bus in one hour= 160 / 4 
= 40 

Distance traveled by bus in one hour= 320 / 5
= 64

Ratio = 40 : 64
= 5 : 8

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ১২) Sani, Sabbir, and Salman started a business. Sani 1/2 part, Sabbir 1/3 part, and the rest of the capital were invested by Salman. The ratio of their profits be?
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Question: Sani, Sabbir, and Salman started a business. Sani 1/2 part, Sabbir 1/3 part, and the rest of the capital were invested by Salman. The ratio of their profits be?

Solution:
Let the total capital be 6x
Then, Sani's share = 6x × (1/2) = 3x
Sabbir's share = 6x × (1/3) = 2x
Salman's share = 6x - (3x + 2x) = x

So, required ratio = 3x : 2x : x = 3 : 2 : 1

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ১৪) An office opens at 9 a.m. and closes at 5.30 p.m. with a lunch break of 30 minutes. What is the ratio of lunch breaks to the total period in the office?
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Question: An office opens at 9 a.m. and closes at 5.30 p.m. with a lunch break of 30 minutes. What is the ratio of lunch breaks to the total period in the office?

Solution: 
The ratio of lunch breaks to the total period in the office = 30/{(8 × 60) + 30}
= 30/510
= 1/17

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ১৫) A and B started a business in partnership investing Tk. 20,000 and Tk. 15,000 respectively. After six months, C joined them with Tk. 20,000. What will be B's share in total profit of Tk. 25,000 earned at the end of 2 years from the starting of the business?
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Question: A and B started a business in partnership investing Tk. 20,000 and Tk. 15,000 respectively. After six months, C joined them with Tk. 20,000. What will be B's share in total profit of Tk. 25,000 earned at the end of 2 years from the starting of the business?

Solution:
Here,
A : B : C
= (20,000 x 24) : (15,000 x 24) : (20,000 x 18)
= 4 : 3 : 3.
So, B's share = 25000 x 3/10 = 7,500.
